title: Spark e2e flow
description: A flow is a header document, `---`, then a command list. A subflow is a command list only. See docs/e2e-flows.md.

intent.description: Plain-English behavior under test; agents use it to repair broken flows.

items.description: a locale such as en-US or ar

launchApp.description: [maestro] Launch the app. Restarts it first when running unless stopApp is false.

launchSecondInstance.description: Launch a second instance; pair with assertSingleInstance.

assertSingleInstance.description: Assert exactly one app process is running.

quitApp.description: Quit the app the way a user would.

assertCrashRecovery.description: Assert the app recovers after crashApp.

assertStartup.description: [driver] Assert startup phase timings in milliseconds.

assertWindow.description: Assert window count and state; frame/fullscreen/level/edited/onDisplay apply to `window` (default key).

focusWindow.description: Bring a window to front and make it key.

resizeWindow.description: Resize a window by dragging an edge.

moveWindow.description: Move a window by its title bar.

moveToDisplay.description: Move a window to another display.

assertScale.description: Assert the backing scale factor of a window.

snapWindow.description: Snap a window to a screen layout.

tearOff.description: Drag a tab out into a new window.

to.description: a point such as "50%,20%" or "120,48" (percent of the target, or points from its top-left)

mergeInto.description: Drag a tab into another window's tab bar.

assertWindowsRestored.description: Assert frame, route, scroll and selection per window were restored.

assertGroupMoves.description: Assert child windows move with their parent.

path.description: a menu path such as "File > Export > PDF…"

else.description: a menu path such as "File > Export > PDF…"

assertMenuAlternate.description: Assert the alternate item shown while a modifier is held.

openContextMenu.description: Open a context menu on a target.

selectContextMenu.description: Choose an item in the open context menu.

openDockMenu.description: Open the Dock menu, optionally choosing an item.

openTrayMenu.description: Open the tray menu, optionally choosing an item.

expectItem.description: a menu path such as "File > Export > PDF…"

pressKey.description: [maestro] Press a key, such as Escape, Enter or F5.

shortcut.description: Press a keyboard shortcut, such as cmd+shift+s.

inputText.description: [maestro] Insert text in one step (Maestro inputText).

imeCompose.description: Compose text through an input method and commit a candidate.

setKeyboardLayout.description: Switch the keyboard layout; later shortcuts resolve by character.

holdKey.description: Hold a key or modifier down.

assertTooltip.description: Hover a target and assert its tooltip.

dragAndDrop.description: Drag from one target to another.

dragFromFinder.description: Drag files from the file manager onto a target.

dragToFinder.description: Drag a target to the file manager and expect a file.

dragToDock.description: Drag files onto the Dock icon.

cancelDrag.description: Start a drag, cancel it, and assert the fly-back.

createFixture.description: Create a file for the flow.

modifyFileExternally.description: Change a file behind the app's back.

mountFixtureVolume.description: Mount a disk image as a volume.

handleDialog.description: Complete an open or save panel.

assertDialog.description: Assert an alert, sheet or panel.

setAppAppearance.description: [driver] Override the app's own appearance in-process; the OS setting is untouched (setAppearance changes the OS).

setLocale.description: Set the OS language and region formats.

setSystemClock.description: Shift or set the OS clock.

offset.description: an offset such as "+3d" or an ISO date

else.description: an offset such as "+3d" or an ISO date

sleepSystem.description: Put the OS to sleep and wake it.

simulatePower.description: Simulate power source and thermal state.

lockScreen.description: Lock the screen for a while.

permission.description: Grant, revoke or reset a privacy permission.

assertDockBadge.description: Assert the Dock badge (empty string = no badge).

captureMotion.description: [driver] Record motion samples for a target.

min.description: a length such as 4px (a bare number is pixels)

max.description: a length such as 4px (a bare number is pixels)

interruptAt.description: [driver] Run a command when the running motion reaches a progress point.

assertFrames.description: [driver] Assert frame rate and drops while a command runs (real clock).

assertPaused.description: [driver] Assert a target's animation pauses in a state. Its `when` is that state, so this command cannot take a condition; wrap it in runFlow { when, commands }.

assertNoLayoutThrash.description: [driver] Assert no repeated layout passes while a command runs.

takeScreenshot.description: [driver] [maestro] Capture the app in-process (driver capture, no screen-recording permission).

assertNoFlicker.description: [driver] Assert no blank or partial frames while a command runs.

max.description: a pixel count or a percentage such as 0.5%

assertA11y.description: Assert the accessibility properties of an element.

voiceOver.description: Turn the screen reader on or off.

screenReaderNext.description: Move the screen reader to the next element.

assertCustomActions.description: Assert an element's custom accessibility actions.

assertKeyboardReachable.description: Assert every interactive element is reachable with Tab / full keyboard access.

assertNoTruncation.description: Assert no visible text is truncated.

assertMirrored.description: Assert an element is mirrored for right-to-left layout.

assertNoLeaks.description: [driver] Assert leak counters (windows, views, listeners, native handles) return to baseline.

mockNetwork.description: Serve a fixture for matching requests.

runFlow.description: [maestro] Run a subflow file, or inline commands.

repeat.description: [maestro] Repeat commands a number of times and/or while a condition holds.

extendedWaitUntil.description: [maestro] Wait until a target is visible or gone.

runScript.description: [maestro] Run a sandboxed JS file; for fixture generation only.

manualStep.description: A step a person performs and signs off.

duration.description: a duration such as 120ms, 1.5s or 2m (a bare integer is milliseconds)

text.description: Visible text, a /regex/, or per-platform text { macos, windows }.

window.description: key, main, or { title | index | type | id }.

condition.description: Run the command only when every listed condition holds.
